The '''kasaq mollusk''' was a type of [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusk]] that was covered by a shell.<ref name="TCWnovel" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22&nbsp;BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> as part of a [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|battle]] in the [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Crystal City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]<ref name="TCWnovel" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Christoph system/Legends|Christoph system]]</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] attempted to pass undetected inside a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] deployed by the [[Confederacy military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. To that end, they hid themselves under<ref name="TCWnovel" /> a roughly rectangular-cuboid-shaped<ref name="TCWfilm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> broken section of conduit that covered them like the shell of a kasaq mollusk while the expanding shield passed over them.<ref name="TCWnovel" />

==Behind the scenes==
The kasaq mollusk was mentioned in [[Karen Traviss]]'<ref name="TCWnovel" /> [[July 26]], [[2008]]<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of<ref name="TCWnovel" /> the [[August 15]], 2008 [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|film]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (multimedia project)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' multimedia project]].<ref name="YearByYear" />
